fix.notes: The fix mirrors the approach described in the issue comments (d9c11c3 cut card loading; this cut deck loading). `person.get('num_decks')` correctly returns None (falsy) for persons loaded via load_person_statless who have no decks in the requested season, so has_decks stays False. person_color_counts makes one lightweight SQL round-trip instead of the previous N+1 pattern through load_decks.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `/people/{person}/` page was slow for users with many decks because `Person.decks` (a lazy property) triggered `load_decks()` — which fetches every Deck object with all associated card data — twice: once to set `self.has_decks` and again to build the "Colors Played" bar chart. The deck table itself is populated client-side via AJAX (`livedecktable`), so loading all those Deck objects server-side was pure waste.

## What changed

- **`decksite/data/deck.py`**: Added `person_color_counts(person_id, season_id) -> dict[str, int]` that queries only `deck_cache.colors` (pre-computed JSON) for the given person and season — no card loading, no joins beyond `deck` → `deck_cache`.
- **`decksite/views/person.py`**: Removed `self.decks = person.decks` (which triggered the heavy lazy load) and replaced it with:
  - `self.has_decks = bool(person.get('num_decks'))` — uses the aggregate already computed by `load_people()`.
  - `colors = ds.person_color_counts(person.id, season_id)` — the lightweight new query.

The `View` base class already initialises `self.decks = []`; since the template uses AJAX for the deck table, the empty list is correct.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 847 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected in 18.39s against a live MariaDB 11.8 instance

Fixes #11295

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/deck.py add a person_color_counts(person_id, season_id) function that queries SELECT dc.colors FROM deck d JOIN deck_cache dc ON d.id=dc.deck_id WHERE d.person_id=X (with season filter) — deck_cache already stores pre-computed colors as JSON, so this avoids loading full Deck objects. In decksite/views/person.py:25-36 replace person.decks with this lightweight query for the chart and a COUNT query for has_decks. The livedecktable on the template fetches decks client-side so self.decks is no longer needed.
